description: Use Fleetkeep in ChatGPT to review urgent MOT, tax, service and maintenance actions, search vehicles, and inspect one vehicle's action and reminder history from the signed-in Fleetkeep account. Fleetkeep is read-only in ChatGPT. It cannot create or edit vehicles, send reminders, connect telematics providers or retrieve live provider data.

defaultPrompt: Show the five fleet actions that need attention first.
Search my vehicles and compare their MOT, tax and service dates.
Show the next actions and reminder history for this vehicle.
